lines.text: Two friends walk toward each other, pass, turn around, and meet again.
lines.caption: Two friends walk toward each other, pass, turn around, and meet again.

lines.text: Two walkers first meet twelve kilometers from town A, then turn around at the far end.
lines.caption: Two walkers first meet twelve kilometers from town A, then turn around at the far end.

lines.text: They meet again ten kilometers from town A. How far apart are the towns?
lines.caption: They meet again ten kilometers from town A. How far apart are the towns?

lines.text: Here's the trick. At the first meeting, they've walked one road together. Ann's part is twelve.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. At the first meeting, they've walked one road together. Ann's part is twelve.

lines.text: At the second meeting, that's THREE roads together. So Ann walked thirty-six.
lines.caption: At the second meeting, that's THREE roads together. So Ann walked thirty-six.

lines.text: She walked the whole road, then back to ten kilometers from town A.
lines.caption: She walked the whole road, then back to ten kilometers from town A.

lines.text: So road plus road minus ten is thirty-six. The road is twenty-three kilometers!
lines.caption: So road plus road minus ten is thirty-six. The road is twenty-three kilometers!

lines.text: Want to see why? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Want to see why? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
